title: What capabilities and platforms support customer offboarding
context: We currently handle offboarding in an immature way
request: We need a clear list of platform can capabilities so we can identify areas of maturity improvement
findings:
## Customer Offboarding Capability Overview

### Business Capability Hierarchy

Offboarding is defined as a Level 2 capability under **CAP-001: Customer Management** — specifically **CAP-001-05 (Offboard Customer)**: "Manage the departure of customers, ensuring fair, transparent, and compliant exit from the portfolio."

This breaks down into five Level 3 sub-capabilities:

| Capability ID | Capability Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| CAP-001-05-01 | Notify Customer | Notify customer of account suspension and offboarding timeline |
| CAP-001-05-02 | Handle Data Requests | Process data deletion and data access requests per GDPR/CCPA regulations |
| CAP-001-05-03 | Close Account | Close account and remove system access |
| CAP-001-05-04 | Process Settlement | Process final payment settlement and financial reconciliation |
| CAP-001-05-05 | Notify Compliance & Legal | Notify compliance, legal, and audit teams of customer offboarding |

### Platform Support Assessment

A critical finding: **No platforms currently map to any offboarding capability** in the application capability-to-platform matrix (APP-CAP-DAP).

Of the customer management platforms deployed (in the Customer Engagement domain), none have documented support for offboarding:

- **PLAT-CRM** (Salesforce Sales Cloud, APP-CAT-001) — Maps to Acquire and Service; no offboarding mapping
- **PLAT-DXP** (Oracle Utilities Customer Cloud, APP-CAT-002) — Maps to Service and Retain; no offboarding mapping
- **PLAT-MOBILE-APP** (OutSystems app, APP-CAT-003) — Maps to Service only; no offboarding mapping
- **PLAT-CONTACT-CENTRE** (Genesys Cloud CX, APP-CAT-004) — Maps to Service only; no offboarding mapping
- **PLAT-MARKETING-AUTOMATION** (Salesforce Marketing Cloud, APP-CAT-005) — Maps to Acquire and Retain; no offboarding mapping

### Supporting Platforms for Sub-Capabilities

While no platform directly supports offboarding, the related processes draw on:

- **CAP-001-05-03 (Close Account)** and **CAP-001-05-04 (Process Settlement)** require **PLAT-CIS** (Oracle CC&B, APP-CAT-016) — the Customer Information System that manages account closure and billing settlement
- **CAP-001-05-02 (Handle Data Requests)** may require **PLAT-DATA-LAKEHOUSE** (Databricks, APP-CAT-023) and **PLAT-MDM-MASTER** (Oracle EDM Cloud, APP-CAT-024) for GDPR/CCPA data management
- **CAP-001-05-05 (Notify Compliance & Legal)** likely uses **PLAT-ERP** (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, APP-CAT-027) for compliance and audit workflows

### Maturity Gaps

The absence of platform-level offboarding orchestration suggests offboarding is handled via **manual processes, point integrations, or bespoke workarounds** across these systems. Key maturity opportunities:

1. **Process Orchestration** — No single system owns the offboarding workflow; sub-steps are scattered across CIS, CRM, and data systems
2. **Compliance Automation** — Data deletion and regulatory notifications appear manual
3. **Customer Communication** — No dedicated offboarding notification capability visible
4. **Account Closure Atomicity** — Risk of partial closures if CIS operations fail

### View Basis

As at **version 1.0.0**, dated 2026-01-15. Based on APP-CAP-DAP (Capability-to-Application mapping) and APP-DAP (Application Portfolio) matrices.

---

**Note:** The Customer Information System (PLAT-CIS) and related billing/settlement platforms remain the primary execution points, but the absence of explicit offboarding mappings indicates this capability requires architecture hardening.
